_comment: Organisations shown in the logo row on the landing page. Curated by hand — nothing here is user-writable. Fields: name (required, the full institution name), short (what the row prints under the mark; falls back to name), logo (path under static/, omit or leave empty for a wordmark-only entry), url (optional link). A logo whose file is missing from static/ is dropped server-side and the entry degrades to its wordmark, so a broken path never renders an empty box. See static/logos/README.md for what a usable logo file looks like.
